about.heading: A calmer way to groom.
about.lead: One-to-one dog grooming in Broom for dogs of different breeds, sizes and temperaments.
about.summary: From puppy introductions and nail clipping to full grooms, Lilly’s offers individual grooming in a calm setting.
paragraphs: Lilly’s Dog Grooming is based at Unit 1, 2 Bidford Road in Broom.
Current business information lists one-to-one grooming, hydro-bath services, full grooms, puppy grooms and nail clipping.
Current business information also describes City & Guilds and ICMG qualifications and a particular welcome for anxious dogs.
